title: Hastad core Fourier identity
statement: For every $n\in\mathbb N$, real parameter $\rho$, function $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and sign $b\in\{−1,1\}$, the uniform expectation over independent uniform $x,y\in\{−1,1\}^n$ of $f(x)f(y)$ times the noise operator applied to $f$ at the point whose $i$th coordinate is $b x_i y_i$ equals $\sum_{S\subseteq[n]} b^{|S|}\rho^{|S|}\widehat f(S)^3$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the uniform Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$.
